hero.title: Identity first, tools after
hero.subhead: The professional Master Brain for using AI with judgment.
hero.body: Before you ask AI to write for you, teach it who you are. Build your Master Brain in about 15 minutes, then use it in Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini.
hero.note: Free. Your answers stay on your device.
hero.credit: Presented at Aula Virtual SUJIS, Broward International University.

whatIs.title: What is a Master Brain?
whatIs.body: A short document that teaches AI who you are before you ask it for anything. You paste it at the start of a conversation, and every answer starts from your voice, your values and your limits.
whatIs.request: Write a short professional summary for my LinkedIn.
whatIs.withoutText: Results-driven professional with a passion for excellence and a proven track record of success. Committed to delivering value and leveraging synergies in a dynamic environment.
whatIs.withText: I help small family businesses in Miami explain what they do in plain language. I care more about being trusted than being impressive. I won't promise what I can't deliver, and I'll always tell you the truth first.
whatIs.caption: Same tool. Same request. Different identity.
whatIs.closing: AI amplifies who you are. If you give it nothing, it amplifies the generic.

fourParts.title: The four parts we build today
fourParts.voiceBody: How you sound, and what you would never say.
fourParts.valuesBody: The principles you will not trade for a result.
fourParts.vpBody: Who you help, with what, and what changes for them.
fourParts.limitsBody: What AI must never do or claim on your behalf.
fourParts.note: A full Master Brain has more parts. These four are the foundation.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.step3: Paste it into your AI and start working.

prompt.intro: You are my personal AI assistant. Before you help me with anything, read my Master Brain below and treat it as the source of truth about who I am. Everything you write for me must come from it.
prompt.voice_words: Words people use to describe how I speak or write
prompt.voice_never: A phrase I would never say
prompt.voice_sample: A sample that sounds like me
prompt.values_principles: Principles I will not trade for a result
prompt.values_trust: What I want people to trust me for
prompt.values_story: A moment that shows my values
prompt.limits_never: Things you must never do or claim on my behalf
prompt.limits_ask: Facts you must always ask me about before writing
prompt.limits_disclosure: How I handle AI use in my work
prompt.rule1: Write in my voice, not in generic professional language.
prompt.rule2: Never invent experience, credentials, numbers, dates or quotes. If you need a fact, ask me.
prompt.rule3: Stay inside my limits at all times.
prompt.rule4: When you are unsure, ask me first.
prompt.rule5: At the end of anything you write, list the claims I should verify.
prompt.closing: Reply only with: "Master Brain loaded. What would you like to work on?"

work.title: Put it to work
work.intro: Paste your Master Brain first. Then use any of these. Replace the text in [brackets].
work.copiedAnnounce: Copied. The prompt is on your clipboard.
work.copyFailed: Copy did not work. Select the text and copy it by hand.
work.linkedinPrompt: Using my Master Brain, write three versions of my LinkedIn summary, each under 120 words. Use only the facts I give here: [paste your real experience]. Do not invent anything. Mark anything you are unsure about with [CHECK].
work.coverPrompt: Using my Master Brain, draft a cover letter for this role: [paste job description]. Use only my real experience: [paste]. Keep my voice. Ask me questions before writing if you need facts.
work.interviewPrompt: Act as an interviewer for [role]. Ask me one question at a time. After each answer, tell me what sounded like me and what sounded generic. Never suggest I claim experience I do not have.
work.postPrompt: Using my Master Brain, write a short post about [topic] in my voice. Give two options. Do not exaggerate. Do not use buzzwords I would never say.
work.checkPrompt: Read the text below against my Master Brain. List every sentence that does not sound like me and every claim I would need to verify. Then suggest edits that keep my voice. Text: [paste].
work.auditPrompt: Audit the AI-written text below with these five questions and answer each one briefly. 1. Whose voice is this? 2. What is it based on? 3. What could be wrong or biased? 4. What should I disclose? 5. Who is accountable? End with a list of facts I must verify before using it. Text: [paste].
work.note: AI helps you say the truth better. It should never invent it.

about.title: Who is Andres?
about.photoAlt: Andres Diaz smiling in a dark blazer.
about.bio: Andres Diaz is the founder of The Creative Strategist, a consultancy in South Florida where he works as a fractional CMO and AI specialist. He helps businesses and professionals use AI with their own voice, values and limits, starting from identity before tools.
